tagline: Innovatively Refreshing America with Distinctive Beverages
hero_kpi_rationale: Key performance indicator reflecting the company's organic growth driven by an increase in average selling price per case and an additional week of sales in Fiscal 2025

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company
kpis.description: The company's net sales increased due to higher average selling price per case and an additional week of sales, partially offset by a 0.9% decline in case volume
kpis.signal: Revenue growth driven by higher average selling price per case

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin of the company
kpis.description: The company's gross margin increased by 100 basis points, from 36.0% in Fiscal 2024 to 37.0% in Fiscal 2025, due to lower packaging costs and higher average selling price per case
kpis.signal: Gross margin improvement due to lower packaging costs

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Capital expenditures increased to $36.3M in Fiscal 2025 from $30.2M in Fiscal 2024, aimed at expanding capacity, improving sustainability, and enhancing packaging capabilities at production facilities
kpis.signal: Increased capital spending to improve production capacity
